nodes.label: LongHorizon-Harness
nodes.rationale: Framework for long-horizon agent execution that separates task-state management from environment interaction through Manage-Execute-Audit loop

nodes.label: Manage-Execute-Audit (MEA) Loop
nodes.rationale: Core execution pattern where manager maintains task state, executor performs subtasks in fresh context, and auditor independently verifies environment state

nodes.label: AgentAdapter Interface
nodes.rationale: Lightweight interface enabling interchangeable model and harness backends without modifying native agent loops

nodes.label: WeaveBench
nodes.rationale: Benchmark with 114 long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated GUI and CLI interactions across 8 domains

nodes.label: OSWorld 2.0
nodes.rationale: Benchmark with 108 professional desktop workflow tasks with median human completion time of ~1.6 hours

nodes.label: Terminal-Bench 2.1
nodes.rationale: Benchmark for challenging command-line tasks evaluating agents on realistic software engineering and system administration

nodes.label: Vision Laziness Phenomenon
nodes.rationale: Observation that late alignment causes models to optimize less in vision components and over-rely on pre-existing language priors

nodes.label: Explicit Task State Management
nodes.rationale: Maintaining task state outside execution context, updated only with independently verified facts from environment
